content.name: Ananya Deshpande
content.title: Associate Security Analyst (SOC L1)
content.summary: SOC L1 analyst in Pune with a B.E. in Computer Engineering, a six-month security internship and ISC2 CC. Monitors alerts for banking and insurance clients and helped a client meet the CERT-In six-hour reporting window on a phishing incident. Active in college CTF teams and bug-bounty practice.

experience.title: Cybersecurity Intern
bullets: Tested 14 client web applications against the OWASP Top 10 under supervision, documenting 37 valid findings.
Wrote Burp Suite test notes and reproduction steps that senior testers reused in final client reports.
Automated subdomain enumeration with a Python script, cutting reconnaissance time per engagement by about two hours.

experience.title: Associate Security Analyst (SOC L1)
bullets: Monitor and triage around 120 SIEM alerts per shift for five banking and insurance clients in a 24x7 SOC.
Identified a credential-phishing campaign against a client's branch staff and escalated it in 20 minutes, helping them report to CERT-In within six hours.
Created 15 triage templates in the ticketing tool that brought L1 handling time per alert down by about 25%.
Rotate through night shifts and hand over open cases with clear notes to the next team.

education.details: CGPA 8.9/10 (Savitribai Phule Pune University). Final-year project: phishing URL classifier.

achievements.title: Top 20 finish, national student CTF
achievements.detail: Team of four placed 17th of about 450 teams in a 2024 online capture-the-flag.

achievements.title: Responsible disclosure acknowledgement
achievements.detail: Reported an access-control bug through a public bug-bounty programme in 2024.
